text:
Morgan: heads up — hit a repro in the onboarding sampleapp where a refresh-token race + 429 causes a double side-effect (duplicate email sends). repro steps in logs below. anyone seen this in prod?

Jamie: ugh. can you paste the minimal trace?

Morgan: sure — key part: user request -> expired token refresh -> request retried after 429. our SDK retry loop retries the original request without attaching an idempotency token. snippet: 
```http
POST /v1/send_email
Authorization: Bearer <rotated-token>
Content-Type: application/json
# no Idempotency-Key header
```
Result: server processed the retry and also processed the initial in a race.

Alex: that matches a bug we saw in the Node SDK where auth refresh path returns the in-flight promise but loses the generated idempotency header on retry.

Priya: timeline: 1) client sends request with token A. 2) token refresh triggered (A->B) mid-flight. 3) upstream returns 429 transient to original connection. 4) SDK retries with token B but idempotency header was only added to the original request object.

Jamie: thought we had parity fixes for that? maybe python still ok, node broken?

Alex: parity gap: python builds the final HTTP envelope at retry time (so idempotency header gets regenerated). node mutates and reuses the original envelope object. we'll need to change node to clone or rehydrate headers on retry.

Priya: also worth adding a small server-side "graceful replay handshake" for streaming/long requests: server returns a resume-token in 429 metadata so clients can safely resume instead of blind retry. open to adding as opt-in for Dedicated/private customers.

Morgan: i like resume-token. for the hosted API we could expose header `X-Redwood-Resume` with a short TTL, returned on 429/503. client could then retry with `X-Redwood-Resume: <token>` and server dedups.

Alex: implementation notes for SDKs: 
- ensure every outgoing call attaches `Idempotency-Key` for side-effecting endpoints (if caller didn't provide).
- when doing auth-refresh retry, always recompose headers from a fresh envelope.
- backoff: keep exponential base but add full jitter: `sleep = random_between(0, base * 2^attempt)` to avoid synchronization.

Jamie: small sampleapp patch suggestion: add a tiny harness that simulates token rotation + injected 429s to validate no dupes. should be run in CI.

Priya: agree. also flagging this for the SDK parity doc and the onboarding checklist so integrators know to pass idempotency keys for webhooks/email/send endpoints.

Morgan: created a quick repro branch: https://github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/178 — contains failing test and log dump. can someone pick node SDK change? i'll own the server resume-token POC.

Alex: i'll prep a node PR that clones the envelope and re-adds headers on retry. will add a unit test that simulates race with fake timers.

Jamie: thanks. action items: Alex -> node SDK PR (add regen of headers + idempotency default), Morgan -> resume-token POC + sampleapp CI test, Priya -> update parity checklist + docs. I'll add a short postmortem template if this happens again in prod. :thumbsup:

Priya: noted in docs board: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DX-1283

Morgan: thanks team — appreciate the quick triage.
